scope: Carrier 162x150 compact model screens; baseline plus granular-minor+vertical+estimator-first. No full pipeline acceptance or hardware relaxation.
recipe: Same full recipe as 2026-10-18-failure-subjects.json. Connectivity order 0, failed-first enabled, three continuations, victim shapes enabled, 4096 frontier nodes. First experiment retains 8 poses; second changes only poses to 32 on restored production source.

reordered_continuation_experiment.implementation: After failed-first seating, if an alternative pose had succeeded locally but the remaining layout failed, replay that reordered search with skips 1 through configured continuations; preserve each attempt in fallback accounting.
reordered_continuation_experiment.result: No reordered continuation was activated because no alternative relocation succeeded. Experimental source reverted; production profiler rebuilt.

corrected_subject_evidence: Both strategy failures retain fmc, power and usb_jtag with corrected retry transport. Earlier baseline omission of fmc was not evidence of its absence from the first solve.
interpretation: Zero generated rows include failure to seat the incoming group after removing one victim; they are not proof that the physical board has no space. More nearest poses alone did not recover this outline. Investigate region construction and interacting relocation choices rather than raising the default pose cap or adding inactive continuation work.
limits: Single diagnostic timings, not statistical performance measurements. No source algorithm change retained; no new smaller board. Does not prove global infeasibility or that wider/different search cannot succeed.
